DEP_D0_independent.description: Independent sampling from marginal predictive distributions (mandatory baseline)

DEP_D2_gaussian_copula.description: Gaussian copula with pre-cutoff correlation kernel or latent common factors

DEP_D3_tail_copula.description: Tail-dependent copula (conditionally opened on development co-exceedance failure of D2)

dependence_construction_requirements.variable_daily_n: Must support arbitrary daily flight count n_d without fixed n x n matrix assumption
dependence_construction_requirements.pre_cutoff_conditioning_only: Conditioning strictly restricted to pre-cutoff schedule covariates (time, carrier mix, density)
dependence_construction_requirements.no_realized_conditioning: Conditioning on realized delays, cancellations, or actual weather is strictly prohibited
dependence_construction_requirements.psd_safety_enforcement: Kernel/factor structure or nearest-PSD projection with minimum eigenvalue >= 1e-6
dependence_construction_requirements.no_double_counting: Dependence layer must not inject variance already captured in marginal distributions

discrete_pit_policy.randomized_pit_formula: U_i = F(Y_i - 1) + V_i * [F(Y_i) - F(Y_i - 1)], V_i ~ Uniform(0, 1)
discrete_pit_policy.sensitivity_evaluation: Assess copula parameter stability across 10 randomized PIT draws
